```{r init, include=FALSE}
palette_for_levels <- function(levels, reference_palette = amino_acid_palette, fallback_palette = "Set 3") {
  levels <- unique(as.character(levels))
  if (length(levels) == 0) return(setNames(character(), character()))
  out <- reference_palette[levels]
  missing_levels <- levels[is.na(out)]
  if (length(missing_levels) > 0) {
    extra <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(missing_levels), palette = fallback_palette), missing_levels)
    out[missing_levels] <- extra[missing_levels]
  }
  out[levels]
}

format_origin_label <- function(x) recode(x, Genomic = "Genomic tRNA", Mitochondrial = "Mitochondrial tRNA")

format_cleavage_label <- function(origin_name, cleavage_name) {
  if (origin_name == "Genomic") {
    recode(
      cleavage_name,
      "5'end" = "Genomic tRNA 5'end",
      "3'end" = "Genomic tRNA 3'end",
      "CCA-end" = "Genomic tRNA CCA-end",
      "Internal/full" = "Genomic tRNA internal"
    )
  } else {
    recode(
      cleavage_name,
      "5'end" = "Mitochondrial tRNA 5'end",
      "3'end" = "Mitochondrial tRNA 3'end",
      "CCA-end" = "Mitochondrial tRNA CCA-end",
      "Internal/full" = "Mitochondrial tRNA internal"
    )
  }
}

build_single_spider_plot <- function(plot_df, value_col, color_value, title_text) {
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No spider data available."))
  axis_levels <- levels(plot_df$AminoAcid)
  if (is.null(axis_levels)) axis_levels <- unique(as.character(plot_df$AminoAcid))
  axis_levels <- axis_levels[!is.na(axis_levels)]
  polar_start <- 0
  radial_max <- max(ceiling(max(plot_df[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)), 1)
  radial_breaks <- unique(round(seq(0, radial_max, length.out = 4), 1))
  radial_offset <- if (length(radial_breaks) > 1) radial_breaks[2] else max(radial_max * 0.25, 0.25)
  radial_plot_breaks <- radial_breaks + radial_offset
  radial_limit <- radial_max + radial_offset
  radial_label_df <- tibble(
    AxisIndex = 1,
    Radius = radial_plot_breaks,
    Label = as.character(radial_breaks)
  )

  axis_grid_df <- tibble(
    AxisIndex = seq_along(axis_levels),
    AxisLabel = factor(axis_levels, levels = axis_levels)
  )

  spider_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      AminoAcid = factor(AminoAcid, levels = axis_levels),
      AxisIndex = as.numeric(AminoAcid),
      .plot_radius = .data[[value_col]] + radial_offset
    ) %>%
    arrange(AxisIndex)

  path_df <- bind_rows(
    spider_df,
    spider_df %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(AxisIndex = length(axis_levels) + 1)
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = radial_plot_breaks, color = mii_neutral_line, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_segment(
      data = axis_grid_df,
      aes(x = AxisIndex, xend = AxisIndex, y = radial_offset, yend = radial_limit),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = mii_neutral_line,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_area(
      data = path_df,
      aes(x = AxisIndex, y = .plot_radius, group = 1),
      fill = grDevices::adjustcolor(color_value, alpha.f = 0.24),
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_path(data = path_df, aes(x = AxisIndex, y = .plot_radius, group = 1), color = color_value, linewidth = 1.2, lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = spider_df, aes(x = AxisIndex, y = .plot_radius), shape = 21, fill = color_value, color = color_value, size = 2.8, stroke = 0.2) +
    geom_text(
      data = radial_label_df,
      aes(x = AxisIndex, y = Radius, label = Label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = mii_neutral_text,
      size = 3,
      vjust = -0.35
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = polar_start, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(axis_levels),
      labels = axis_levels,
      limits = c(1, length(axis_levels) + 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, radial_limit),
      breaks = radial_plot_breaks,
      labels = radial_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title_text) +
    mii_theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = mii_text_primary),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = mii_text_muted),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 18, 10)
    )
}

build_group_spider_plot <- function(plot_df, value_col, title_text) {
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No spider data available."))
  axis_levels <- levels(plot_df$AminoAcid)
  if (is.null(axis_levels)) axis_levels <- unique(as.character(plot_df$AminoAcid))
  axis_levels <- axis_levels[!is.na(axis_levels)]
  polar_start <- 0
  radial_max <- max(ceiling(max(plot_df[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)), 1)
  radial_breaks <- unique(round(seq(0, radial_max, length.out = 4), 1))
  radial_offset <- if (length(radial_breaks) > 1) radial_breaks[2] else max(radial_max * 0.25, 0.25)
  radial_plot_breaks <- radial_breaks + radial_offset
  radial_limit <- radial_max + radial_offset
  radial_label_df <- tibble(
    AxisIndex = 1,
    Radius = radial_plot_breaks,
    Label = as.character(radial_breaks)
  )

  axis_grid_df <- tibble(
    AxisIndex = seq_along(axis_levels),
    AxisLabel = factor(axis_levels, levels = axis_levels)
  )

  spider_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      AminoAcid = factor(AminoAcid, levels = axis_levels),
      AxisIndex = as.numeric(AminoAcid),
      .plot_radius = .data[[value_col]] + radial_offset
    ) %>%
    arrange(Group, AxisIndex)

  path_df <- spider_df %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    group_modify(~bind_rows(.x, .x %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(AxisIndex = length(axis_levels) + 1))) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = radial_plot_breaks, color = mii_neutral_line, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_segment(
      data = axis_grid_df,
      aes(x = AxisIndex, xend = AxisIndex, y = radial_offset, yend = radial_limit),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = mii_neutral_line,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_path(data = path_df, aes(x = AxisIndex, y = .plot_radius, color = Group, group = Group), linewidth = 1.1, lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = spider_df, aes(x = AxisIndex, y = .plot_radius, color = Group, fill = Group, group = Group), shape = 21, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.18) +
    geom_text(
      data = radial_label_df,
      aes(x = AxisIndex, y = Radius, label = Label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = mii_neutral_text,
      size = 3,
      vjust = -0.35
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = polar_start, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(axis_levels),
      labels = axis_levels,
      limits = c(1, length(axis_levels) + 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, radial_limit),
      breaks = radial_plot_breaks,
      labels = radial_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title_text) +
    mii_theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = mii_text_primary),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = mii_text_muted),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 18, 10)
    )
}

prepare_isoacceptor_heatmap_long <- function(detail_df, origin_filter = NULL) {
  out <- detail_df %>%
    filter(AminoAcid != "Unknown", Anticodon != "Unknown")

  if (!is.null(origin_filter)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(Origin == origin_filter)
  }

  out %>%
    left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(
      CleavageGroup = case_when(
        str_detect(SubClass, "CCA_end") ~ "3_CCA",
        str_detect(SubClass, "5_end") ~ "5_end",
        str_detect(SubClass, "3_end") ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ "inner"
      ),
      AnticodonLabel = paste(AminoAcid, Anticodon, sep = "-"),
      RPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * Reads / CleanReads, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(CleavageGroup)) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, CleavageGroup, AnticodonLabel) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("CleavageGroup", "AnticodonLabel"))
}

isoacceptor_heatmap_gaps <- function(block_size, n_blocks) {
  if (n_blocks <= 1) return(integer(0))
  seq(block_size, block_size * (n_blocks - 1), by = block_size)
}

add_column_block_annotation <- function(heatmap_gtable, block_labels, block_sizes, block_colors, gaps_col, row_name, fontsize = 10, border_color = "grey60") {
  if (!pkg_has("gtable")) return(heatmap_gtable)

  layout <- heatmap_gtable$layout
  matrix_idx <- which(layout$name == "matrix")
  annotation_idx <- which(layout$name == "col_annotation")
  if (length(matrix_idx) == 0 || length(annotation_idx) == 0) return(heatmap_gtable)

  n_cols <- sum(block_sizes)
  starts <- cumsum(c(1L, head(block_sizes, -1L)))
  ends <- cumsum(block_sizes)
  coord <- getFromNamespace("find_coordinates", "pheatmap")(n_cols, gaps_col)
  block_left <- coord$coord[starts] - coord$size
  block_right <- coord$coord[ends]
  block_width <- block_right - block_left
  block_x <- block_left + 0.5 * block_width

  block_grob <- grid::grobTree(
    grid::rectGrob(
      x = block_x,
      y = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
      width = block_width,
      height = grid::unit(fontsize, "bigpts"),
      gp = grid::gpar(fill = unname(block_colors[block_labels]), col = border_color, lwd = 0.35)
    ),
    grid::textGrob(
      label = block_labels,
      x = block_x,
      y = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
      gp = grid::gpar(col = mii_text_primary, fontsize = fontsize * 0.78, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )

  insert_after <- min(layout$t[annotation_idx]) - 1
  heatmap_gtable <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(heatmap_gtable, grid::unit(fontsize + 4, "bigpts"), pos = insert_after)
  heatmap_gtable <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
    heatmap_gtable,
    block_grob,
    t = insert_after + 1,
    l = layout$l[matrix_idx],
    b = insert_after + 1,
    r = layout$r[matrix_idx],
    name = "cleavage_block_annotation",
    clip = "off"
  )

  annotation_name_idx <- which(layout$name == "col_annotation_names")
  if (length(annotation_name_idx) > 0) {
    heatmap_gtable <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
      heatmap_gtable,
      grid::textGrob(row_name, x = grid::unit(0, "npc"), just = "left", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize)),
      t = insert_after + 1,
      l = layout$l[annotation_name_idx],
      b = insert_after + 1,
      r = layout$r[annotation_name_idx],
      name = "cleavage_block_annotation_name",
      clip = "off"
    )
  }

  heatmap_gtable
}

render_isoacceptor_heatmap <- function(heatmap_long, output_name, title_text, value_mode = c("log", "zscore"), column_layout = c("cleavage_major", "group_major")) {
  cleavage_order <- c("3_CCA", "inner", "5_end")
  value_mode <- match.arg(value_mode)
  column_layout <- match.arg(column_layout)
  if (nrow(heatmap_long) == 0 || !pkg_has("pheatmap")) return(invisible(NULL))

  top_labels <- heatmap_long %>%
    group_by(AnticodonLabel) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 36) %>%
    pull(AnticodonLabel)

  cleavage_colors <- c(
    "3_CCA" = ts_cleavage_palette[["CCA-end"]],
    "inner" = ts_cleavage_palette[["Internal/full"]],
    "5_end" = ts_cleavage_palette[["5'end"]]
  )

  if (column_layout == "cleavage_major") {
    column_levels <- unlist(lapply(cleavage_order, function(cg) paste(cg, group_levels, sep = "__")))
    annotation_col <- data.frame(
      Group = factor(rep(group_levels, times = length(cleavage_order)), levels = group_levels),
      row.names = column_levels
    )
    annotation_colors <- list(Group = group_palette)
    labels_col <- rep(group_levels, times = length(cleavage_order))
    block_labels <- cleavage_order
    block_sizes <- rep(length(group_levels), length(cleavage_order))
    block_colors <- cleavage_colors
    block_row_name <- "Cleavage"
    gaps_col <- isoacceptor_heatmap_gaps(length(group_levels), length(cleavage_order))
  } else {
    column_levels <- unlist(lapply(group_levels, function(group_name) paste(cleavage_order, group_name, sep = "__")))
    annotation_col <- data.frame(
      Cleavage = factor(rep(cleavage_order, times = length(group_levels)), levels = cleavage_order),
      row.names = column_levels
    )
    annotation_colors <- list(Cleavage = cleavage_colors)
    labels_col <- rep(cleavage_order, times = length(group_levels))
    block_labels <- group_levels
    block_sizes <- rep(length(cleavage_order), length(group_levels))
    block_colors <- group_palette[group_levels]
    block_row_name <- "Group"
    gaps_col <- isoacceptor_heatmap_gaps(length(cleavage_order), length(group_levels))
  }

  heatmap_ready <- heatmap_long %>%
    filter(AnticodonLabel %in% top_labels, CleavageGroup %in% cleavage_order) %>%
    complete(
      AnticodonLabel = top_labels,
      CleavageGroup = cleavage_order,
      Group = group_levels,
      fill = list(RPM = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(ColumnKey = factor(paste(CleavageGroup, Group, sep = "__"), levels = column_levels))

  heatmap_wide <- heatmap_ready %>%
    select(AnticodonLabel, ColumnKey, RPM) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ColumnKey, values_from = RPM, values_fill = 0)

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>% select(-AnticodonLabel) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_wide$AnticodonLabel
  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, column_levels, drop = FALSE]
  heatmap_matrix <- log10(heatmap_matrix + 1)
  if (value_mode == "zscore") {
    heatmap_matrix <- safe_scale_rows(heatmap_matrix)
    heatmap_matrix <- pmax(pmin(heatmap_matrix, 2), -2)
    heatmap_breaks <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 102)
    heatmap_legend_breaks <- seq(-2, 2, by = 1)
    heatmap_legend_labels <- as.character(heatmap_legend_breaks)
  } else {
    heatmap_matrix <- pmin(heatmap_matrix, 2)
    heatmap_breaks <- seq(0, 2, length.out = 102)
    heatmap_legend_breaks <- seq(0, 2, by = 0.5)
    heatmap_legend_labels <- c("0", "0.5", "1.0", "1.5", "2.0")
  }

  heatmap_dir <- build_nested_dir(TSRNA_COMPARE_FIG, "05_isoacceptor_heatmap", view = REPORT_VIEW)
  pdf_path <- file.path(heatmap_dir, output_name)
  heatmap_height <- max(8, nrow(heatmap_matrix) * 0.24 + 2.8)

  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_col = gaps_col,
    border_color = "grey60",
    color = grDevices::colorRampPalette(mii_heatmap_gradient)(101),
    breaks = heatmap_breaks,
    legend_breaks = heatmap_legend_breaks,
    legend_labels = heatmap_legend_labels,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    labels_col = labels_col,
    angle_col = 0,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    fontsize_row = 8,
    main = title_text,
    width = 10.5,
    height = heatmap_height,
    silent = TRUE
  )
  heatmap_gtable <- add_column_block_annotation(
    heatmap_plot$gtable,
    block_labels = block_labels,
    block_sizes = block_sizes,
    block_colors = block_colors,
    gaps_col = gaps_col,
    row_name = block_row_name,
    fontsize = 10
  )

  save_plot_device(
    pdf_path,
    width = 10.5,
    height = heatmap_height,
    draw_fn = function() {
      grid::grid.newpage()
      grid::grid.draw(heatmap_gtable)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r tsrna-origin-compare, include=FALSE}
group_origin_plot_df <- group_tsrna_origin_view %>%
  mutate(OriginLabel = format_origin_label(Origin))

for (group_name in group_levels) {
  origin_plot <- plot_percent_pie(
    group_origin_plot_df %>% filter(Group == group_name) %>% transmute(Group, Origin = OriginLabel, Reads, Percent),
    "Origin",
    ts_origin_palette,
    paste0("Group ", group_name, " tsRNA origin"),
    "No tsRNA origin data available."
  )
  save_plot_nested(origin_plot, "01_origin", paste0("group_", safe_dir_name(group_name), ".pdf"), width = 6, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}

tsrna_origin_trend <- group_origin_plot_df %>%
  transmute(Group, TrendCategory = OriginLabel, Reads, Percent)
tsrna_origin_levels <- names(ts_origin_palette)[names(ts_origin_palette) %in% unique(tsrna_origin_trend$TrendCategory)]

if (length(tsrna_origin_levels) >= 2) {
  origin_percent_bar <- build_trend_bar_plot(tsrna_origin_trend, tsrna_origin_levels, "Percent", "tsRNA origin across groups", "Proportion within tsRNA (%)", group_levels, fill_palette = ts_origin_palette)
  origin_percent_alluvial <- build_trend_alluvial_plot(tsrna_origin_trend, tsrna_origin_levels, "Percent", "Alluvial plot of tsRNA origin across groups", "Proportion within tsRNA (%)", group_levels, fill_palette = ts_origin_palette)
  origin_reads_bar <- build_trend_bar_plot(tsrna_origin_trend, tsrna_origin_levels, "Reads", "tsRNA origin reads across groups", "Reads", group_levels, fill_palette = ts_origin_palette)
  origin_reads_alluvial <- build_trend_alluvial_plot(tsrna_origin_trend, tsrna_origin_levels, "Reads", "Alluvial plot of tsRNA origin reads across groups", "Reads", group_levels, fill_palette = ts_origin_palette)

  save_plot_nested(origin_percent_bar, "01_origin", "group_compare_percent_bar.pdf", width = 9, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  save_plot_nested(origin_percent_alluvial, "01_origin", "group_compare_percent_alluvial.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  save_plot_nested(origin_reads_bar, "01_origin", "group_compare_reads_bar.pdf", width = 9, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  save_plot_nested(origin_reads_alluvial, "01_origin", "group_compare_reads_alluvial.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}
```

```{r tsrna-cleavage-compare, include=FALSE}
group_cleavage_plot_df <- group_tsrna_cleavage_view %>%
  mutate(CleavageLabel = map2_chr(Origin, Cleavage, format_cleavage_label))

for (group_name in group_levels) {
  genomic_plot <- plot_percent_pie(
    group_cleavage_plot_df %>%
      filter(Group == group_name, Origin == "Genomic") %>%
      transmute(Group, Cleavage = CleavageLabel, Reads, Percent),
    "Cleavage",
    ts_genomic_palette,
    paste0("Group ", group_name, " genomic tsRNA cleavage"),
    "No genomic tsRNA cleavage data available."
  )
  mito_plot <- plot_percent_pie(
    group_cleavage_plot_df %>%
      filter(Group == group_name, Origin == "Mitochondrial") %>%
      transmute(Group, Cleavage = CleavageLabel, Reads, Percent),
    "Cleavage",
    ts_mito_palette,
    paste0("Group ", group_name, " mitochondrial tsRNA cleavage"),
    "No mitochondrial tsRNA cleavage data available."
  )
  combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(genomic_plot, mito_plot),
    title_text = paste0("Group ", group_name, " tsRNA cleavage"),
    cols = 2
  )
  save_plot_nested(combined_plot, "02_cleavage", paste0("group_", safe_dir_name(group_name), ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}

for (origin_name in c("Genomic", "Mitochondrial")) {
  origin_df <- group_cleavage_plot_df %>%
    filter(Origin == origin_name) %>%
    transmute(Group, TrendCategory = CleavageLabel, Reads, Percent)
  cleavage_levels <- unique(as.character(origin_df$TrendCategory))
  if (length(cleavage_levels) < 2) next

  cleavage_palette <- if (origin_name == "Genomic") ts_genomic_palette else ts_mito_palette
  file_prefix <- if (origin_name == "Genomic") "genomic" else "mitochondrial"

  save_plot_nested(
    build_trend_bar_plot(origin_df, cleavage_levels, "Percent", paste0(origin_name, " tsRNA cleavage across groups"), "Proportion (%)", group_levels, fill_palette = cleavage_palette),
    "02_cleavage",
    paste0(file_prefix, "_group_compare_bar.pdf"),
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    build_trend_alluvial_plot(origin_df, cleavage_levels, "Percent", paste0("Alluvial of ", origin_name, " tsRNA cleavage across groups"), "Proportion (%)", group_levels, fill_palette = cleavage_palette),
    "02_cleavage",
    paste0(file_prefix, "_group_compare_alluvial.pdf"),
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r amino-acid-data, include=FALSE}
aa_sample_df <- tsrna_base_detail %>%
  filter(AminoAcid != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, AminoAcid) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(RPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * Reads / CleanReads, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

aa_group_df <- aa_sample_df %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("AminoAcid") %>%
  left_join(
    aa_sample_df %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("AminoAcid") %>%
      select(Group, AminoAcid, Percent),
    by = c("Group", "AminoAcid")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Percent = replace_na(Percent, 0))

aa_levels <- aa_group_df %>%
```

```{r tsrna-origin-pattern-heatmap, include=FALSE}
tsrna_origin_pattern <- tsrna_cleavage_detail %>%
  filter(AminoAcid != "Unknown", Anticodon != "Unknown") %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    AnticodonLabel = paste(AminoAcid, Anticodon, sep = "-"),
    CleavagePattern = case_when(
      Cleavage == "CCA-end" ~ "3_CCA",
      Cleavage == "5'end" ~ "5_end",
      Cleavage == "3'end" ~ "3_end",
      TRUE ~ "inner"
    ),
    RPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * Reads / CleanReads, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Origin, CleavagePattern, AnticodonLabel) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("Origin", "CleavagePattern", "AnticodonLabel"))

plot_tsrna_origin_pattern <- function(pattern_df, origin_name, output_name) {
  origin_df <- pattern_df %>% filter(Origin == origin_name)
  if (nrow(origin_df) == 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0(origin_name, " tsRNA origin pattern"), "No tsRNA origin pattern data available."),
      "07_origin_pattern",
      output_name,
      width = 8,
      height = 5,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  top_labels <- origin_df %>%
    group_by(AnticodonLabel) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM), AnticodonLabel) %>%
    slice_head(n = 36) %>%
    pull(AnticodonLabel)

  plot_df <- origin_df %>%
    filter(AnticodonLabel %in% top_labels) %>%
    complete(
      CleavagePattern = c("5_end", "inner", "3_end", "3_CCA"),
      Group = group_levels,
      AnticodonLabel = top_labels,
      fill = list(RPM = 0, Reads = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(AnticodonLabel) %>%
    mutate(
      logRPM = log10(RPM + 1),
      ZScore = {
        scaled <- as.numeric(scale(logRPM))
        ifelse(is.finite(scaled), scaled, 0)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
      CleavagePattern = factor(CleavagePattern, levels = c("5_end", "inner", "3_end", "3_CCA")),
      AnticodonLabel = factor(AnticodonLabel, levels = rev(top_labels))
    )

  origin_pattern_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Group, y = AnticodonLabel, fill = pmax(pmin(ZScore, 2), -2))) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~CleavagePattern, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = mii_heatmap_gradient, limits = c(-2, 2), name = "Z-score") +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0(origin_name, " tsRNA origin pattern by cleavage")
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = mii_neutral_line),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  save_plot_nested(
    origin_pattern_plot,
    "07_origin_pattern",
    output_name,
    width = 12,
    height = max(6.5, length(top_labels) * 0.18 + 2.5),
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

plot_tsrna_origin_pattern(tsrna_origin_pattern, "Genomic", "genomic_tsRNA_origin_pattern.pdf")
plot_tsrna_origin_pattern(tsrna_origin_pattern, "Mitochondrial", "mitochondrial_tsRNA_origin_pattern.pdf")
```

```{r tsrna-mapping-profile, include=FALSE}
build_tsrna_mapping_profile_path <- function(sample_id) {
  file.path(sports_sample_processed_dir(sample_id), paste0(sample_id, "_tRNA_mature_mapping.txt"))
}

build_tsrna_mapping_detail_path <- function(sample_id) {
  file.path(sports_sample_processed_dir(sample_id), paste0(sample_id, "_output_tRNA_mature"))
}

mapping_profile_mode <- "raw_recomputed_from_output_tRNA_mature"

normalize_mapping_trna_name <- function(x) {
  str_replace(as.character(x), "-[0-9]+$", "")
}

read_tsrna_mapping_profile <- function(sample_id) {
  detail_file <- build_tsrna_mapping_detail_path(sample_id)
  profile_file <- build_tsrna_mapping_profile_path(sample_id)
  empty_profile <- tibble(
    Sample = character(),
    tRNA = character(),
    Position = integer(),
    RPM = numeric(),
    MappingProfileFile = character(),
    MappingDetailFile = character(),
    MappingProfileMode = character()
  )
  if (!file.exists(detail_file)) {
    return(empty_profile)
  }

  clean_total <- clean_reads_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == as.character(sample_id)) %>%
    pull(CleanReads) %>%
    first()
  clean_total <- clean_numeric(clean_total)
  if (!is.finite(clean_total) || clean_total <= 0) return(empty_profile)

  detail <- read_alignment_tsv_flex(
    detail_file,
    c("ReadID", "ReadCount", "Strand", "Annotation", "StartSite", "Sequence", "Quality", "MismatchN", "EditInfo")
  )
  if (nrow(detail) == 0) return(empty_profile)

  if (pkg_has("data.table")) {
    dt <- data.table::as.data.table(detail)
    dt[, ReadID := as.character(ReadID)]
    dt[, ReadCount := clean_numeric(ReadCount)]
    dt[, StartSite := clean_numeric(StartSite)]
    dt[, Sequence := as.character(Sequence)]
    dt[, RefToken := sub(" .*", "", as.character(Annotation))]
    dt[, RefName := sub("-[^-]+$", "", RefToken)]
    dt[, tRNA := normalize_mapping_trna_name(RefName)]
    dt[, ReadLength := nchar(Sequence)]
    dt <- dt[
      !is.na(ReadID) & ReadID != "" &
        !is.na(ReadCount) & ReadCount > 0 &
        !is.na(StartSite) & StartSite >= 0 &
        !is.na(ReadLength) & ReadLength > 0 &
        !is.na(tRNA) & tRNA != ""
    ]
    if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(empty_profile)
    dt[, RepeatSites := .N, by = ReadID]
    dt[, Contribution := ReadCount / RepeatSites * 1e6 / clean_total]
    dt[, RowID := .I]
    expanded <- dt[, .(
      Position = as.integer(StartSite + seq_len(ReadLength)),
      RPM = rep(Contribution, ReadLength)
    ), by = .(RowID, tRNA)]
    profile <- expanded[, .(RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(tRNA, Position)]
    return(
      as_tibble(profile) %>%
        mutate(
          Sample = as.character(sample_id),
          MappingProfileFile = profile_file,
          MappingDetailFile = detail_file,
          MappingProfileMode = mapping_profile_mode
        ) %>%
        select(Sample, tRNA, Position, RPM, MappingProfileFile, MappingDetailFile, MappingProfileMode)
    )
  }

  repeat_sites <- detail %>%
    count(ReadID, name = "RepeatSites")
  detail %>%
    left_join(repeat_sites, by = "ReadID") %>%
    mutate(
      ReadCount = clean_numeric(ReadCount),
      StartSite = clean_numeric(StartSite),
      Sequence = as.character(Sequence),
      RefToken = str_replace(as.character(Annotation), " .*", ""),
      RefName = str_replace(RefToken, "-[^-]+$", ""),
      tRNA = normalize_mapping_trna_name(RefName),
      ReadLength = nchar(Sequence),
      Contribution = ReadCount / RepeatSites * 1e6 / clean_total
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ReadID), ReadID != "",
      !is.na(ReadCount), ReadCount > 0,
      !is.na(StartSite), StartSite >= 0,
      !is.na(ReadLength), ReadLength > 0,
      !is.na(tRNA), tRNA != ""
    ) %>%
    mutate(RowID = row_number()) %>%
    pmap_dfr(function(ReadID, ReadCount, Strand, Annotation, StartSite, Sequence, Quality, MismatchN, EditInfo, RepeatSites, RefToken, RefName, tRNA, ReadLength, Contribution, RowID) {
      tibble(tRNA = tRNA, Position = as.integer(StartSite + seq_len(ReadLength)), RPM = Contribution)
    }) %>%
    group_by(tRNA, Position) %>%
    summarise(RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = as.character(sample_id),
      MappingProfileFile = profile_file,
      MappingDetailFile = detail_file,
      MappingProfileMode = mapping_profile_mode
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, tRNA, Position, RPM, MappingProfileFile, MappingDetailFile, MappingProfileMode)
}

tsrna_mapping_profile_index <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    MappingDetailFile = map_chr(Sample, build_tsrna_mapping_detail_path),
    MappingDetailExists = file.exists(MappingDetailFile),
    MappingProfileFile = map_chr(Sample, build_tsrna_mapping_profile_path),
    MappingProfileExists = file.exists(MappingProfileFile),
    MappingProfileMode = mapping_profile_mode,
    UseInInterpretation = MappingDetailExists,
    Reason = case_when(
      !MappingDetailExists ~ "Missing *_output_tRNA_mature detail file; profile cannot be recomputed.",
      TRUE ~ "Profile recomputed from the complete *_output_tRNA_mature file."
    )
  )

missing_tsrna_mapping_profiles <- tsrna_mapping_profile_index %>% filter(!MappingDetailExists)
if (nrow(missing_tsrna_mapping_profiles) > 0) {
  warning("Missing tsRNA mapping detail files for samples: ", paste(missing_tsrna_mapping_profiles$Sample, collapse = ", "))
}

tsrna_mapping_sample_profiles <- map_dfr(as.character(sample_info$Sample), read_tsrna_mapping_profile) %>%
  left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample") %>%
  select(Sample, Group, tRNA, Position, RPM, MappingProfileFile, MappingDetailFile, MappingProfileMode)

tsrna_mapping_group_profiles <- tsrna_mapping_sample_profiles %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("tRNA", "Position")) %>%
  transmute(Group, tRNA, Position, MeanRPM = RPM) %>%
  left_join(
    tsrna_mapping_sample_profiles %>%
      group_by(Group, tRNA, Position) %>%
      summarise(
        SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
        MappingProfileMode = paste(sort(unique(MappingProfileMode)), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("Group", "tRNA", "Position")
  ) %>%
  mutate(SampleN = replace_na(SampleN, 0L), MappingProfileMode = replace_na(MappingProfileMode, "")) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

tsrna_mapping_group_profiles_wide <- tsrna_mapping_group_profiles %>%
  mutate(Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  select(tRNA, Position, Group, MeanRPM) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = MeanRPM, values_fill = 0)

for (group_name in group_levels) {
  if (!group_name %in% names(tsrna_mapping_group_profiles_wide)) {
    tsrna_mapping_group_profiles_wide[[group_name]] <- 0
  }
}
tsrna_mapping_group_profiles_wide <- tsrna_mapping_group_profiles_wide %>%
  select(tRNA, Position, all_of(group_levels)) %>%
  arrange(tRNA, Position)

top_mapping_trnas <- tsrna_mapping_group_profiles %>%
  group_by(tRNA) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(MeanRPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), tRNA) %>%
  slice_head(n = 16) %>%
  pull(tRNA)

tsrna_mapping_profile_plot <- if (length(top_mapping_trnas) == 0) {
  plot_note("tsRNA mapping profiles", "No tRNA mapping profile data available.")
} else {
  tsrna_mapping_plot_df <- tsrna_mapping_group_profiles %>%
    filter(tRNA %in% top_mapping_trnas) %>%
    mutate(tRNA = factor(tRNA, levels = top_mapping_trnas))

  ggplot(tsrna_mapping_plot_df, aes(x = Position, y = MeanRPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.95) +
    facet_wrap(~tRNA, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(x = "tRNA position", y = "Mean RPM", title = "tsRNA mapping profiles across groups") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = mii_neutral_line),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

save_plot_nested(
  tsrna_mapping_profile_plot,
  "08_mapping_profile",
  "tsRNA_mapping_profiles.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r tsrna-de, include=FALSE}
sig_col <- if ("SignificanceMetric" %in% names(sequence_de_results)) {
```

```{r tsrna-function-tsrna-candidates, include=FALSE}
tsrna_abundance <- output_all %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "tsRNA", !is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
  group_by(Sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    TopAnnotation = {
      ann_counts <- sort(table(PrimaryAnnotation), decreasing = TRUE)
      if (length(ann_counts) == 0) "unannotated" else names(ann_counts)[[1]]
    },
    TotalReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    Length = Length[which.max(Reads)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalReads))

tsrna_de_candidates <- if (nrow(sequence_de_results) > 0 && !is.na(sig_col) && all(c("Feature", "direction") %in% names(sequence_de_results))) {
  sequence_de_results %>%
    filter(FeatureCategory %in% c("tsRNA", "mt_tsRNA"), direction != "ns") %>%
    mutate(SignificanceMetric = as.numeric(.data[[sig_col]])) %>%
    arrange(SignificanceMetric, desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    select(any_of(c("Feature", "FeatureCategory", "TopAnnotation", "TotalReads", "logFC", "PValue", "FDR", "SignificanceMetric", "direction", "contrast"))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 100)
} else {
  tibble()
}

tsrna_function_candidates <- if (nrow(tsrna_de_candidates) > 0) {
  tsrna_de_candidates %>%
    mutate(candidate_basis = "sequence-level DE with FDR-controlled direction where available")
} else {
  tsrna_abundance %>%
    slice_head(n = 100) %>%
    transmute(
      Feature = Sequence,
      FeatureCategory = "tsRNA",
      TopAnnotation,
      TotalReads,
      logFC = NA_real_,
      PValue = NA_real_,
      FDR = NA_real_,
      SignificanceMetric = NA_real_,
      direction = "abundance_ranked",
      contrast = NA_character_,
      candidate_basis = "top abundance; no significant sequence-level tsRNA DE was available"
    )
}

tsrna_structure_summary <- tsrna_cleavage_detail %>%
  group_by(Origin, Cleavage, AminoAcid, Anticodon) %>%
  summarise(TotalReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), SampleN = n_distinct(Sample), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalReads))

write_csv_safe(tsrna_function_candidates, "11_function_candidates/tsrna_function_candidate_summary.csv")
write_csv_safe(tsrna_structure_summary, "11_function_candidates/tsrna_origin_cleavage_aa_anticodon_summary.csv")

if (nrow(tsrna_function_candidates) > 0) {
  ts_plot_df <- tsrna_function_candidates %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(
      LabelRaw = if_else(!is.na(TopAnnotation) & nzchar(TopAnnotation), as.character(TopAnnotation), as.character(Feature)),
      Label = make.unique(substr(LabelRaw, 1, 45)),
      Label = factor(Label, levels = rev(Label))
    )

  ts_plot <- ggplot(ts_plot_df, aes(x = Label, y = TotalReads, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(mii_direction_palette, abundance_ranked = mii_purple), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "tsRNA candidates for functional follow-up", x = NULL, y = "Total reads", fill = NULL) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  save_plot_nested(ts_plot, "11_function_candidates", "tsrna_function_candidate_reads.pdf", width = 10, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  save_plot_nested(plot_note("tsRNA candidates", "No tsRNA records were available."), "11_function_candidates", "tsrna_candidate_note.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}
```
